items.actClause:
AN ACT to authorize the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept an
application for exemption from real property taxes from Iglesia Long Island
Para Cristo Inc. for a certain parcel in the town of Hempstead
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5667

SPONSOR: THOMAS
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to authorize the assessor of the county of
Nassau to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes
from Iglesia Long Island Para Cristo Inc. for a certain parcel in the
town of Hempstead

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To authorize Iglesia Long Island Para Cristo, Inc. to file an applica-
tion with the Nassau County Assessor for a retroactive property tax
exemption.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one authorizes the Nassau County Assessor to accept an applica-
tion from Iglesia Long Island Para Cristo, Inc. for exemption from real
property taxes pursuant to section 420-a of the Real Property Tax Law
for a portion of the 2015-2016 school and a portion of the 2016 general
tax roll, and the 2016-2017 school and 2017 general tax roll for the
parcel located in the town of Hempstead at 177 Harvard Street, Hemp-
stead, otherwise known as: section 34, block 248, lot 109 and 110.

Section two provides the effective date

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Iglesia Long Island Para Cristo, Inc. is a not-for-profit faith
based organization. The organization recently purchased property on in
the Town of Hempstead, Nassau County and while they are qualified to
apply for a tax exemption under section 420-a of the Real Property Tax
Law, due to the timing purchase, they could not apply for an exemption
for tax years 2015-2016 and 2016-2017. This legislation would allow the
assessor to accept and act on an application for these tax years, giving
Iglesia Long Island Para Cristo, Inc. the tax relief they seek.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2017-2018: A9539- referred to real property taxation/ reported referred
to ways and means.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
90 days after enactment.
